scene.label: Act 3, Scene 5
scene.title: SCENE V. London. The Tower Walls

content.text: Enter Richard and Buckingham in rotten armour, marvellous ill-favoured.

lines.text: Come, cousin, canst thou quake and change thy colour,
lines.plainText: Come cousin canst thou quake and change thy colour

lines.text: Murder thy breath in middle of a word,
lines.plainText: Murder thy breath in middle of a word

lines.text: And then again begin, and stop again,
lines.plainText: And then again begin and stop again

lines.text: As if thou were distraught and mad with terror?
lines.plainText: As if thou were distraught and mad with terror

lines.text: Tut, I can counterfeit the deep tragedian;
lines.plainText: Tut I can counterfeit the deep tragedian

lines.text: Speak, and look back, and pry on every side,
lines.plainText: Speak and look back and pry on every side

lines.text: Tremble and start at wagging of a straw,
lines.plainText: Tremble and start at wagging of a straw

lines.text: Intending deep suspicion. Ghastly looks
lines.plainText: Intending deep suspicion Ghastly looks

lines.text: Are at my service, like enforced smiles,
lines.plainText: Are at my service like enforced smiles

lines.text: And both are ready in their offices,
lines.plainText: And both are ready in their offices

lines.text: At anytime to grace my stratagems.
lines.plainText: At anytime to grace my stratagems

lines.text: But what, is Catesby gone?
lines.plainText: But what is Catesby gone

lines.text: He is; and, see, he brings the Mayor along.
lines.plainText: He is and see he brings the Mayor along

content.text: Enter the Lord Mayor and Catesby.

lines.text: Lord Mayor—
lines.plainText: Lord Mayor

lines.text: Look to the drawbridge there!
lines.plainText: Look to the drawbridge there

lines.text: Hark, a drum.
lines.plainText: Hark a drum

lines.text: Catesby, o'erlook the walls.
lines.plainText: Catesby o'erlook the walls

lines.text: Lord Mayor, the reason we have sent—
lines.plainText: Lord Mayor the reason we have sent

lines.text: Look back! Defend thee, here are enemies.
lines.plainText: Look back Defend thee here are enemies

lines.text: God and our innocence defend and guard us!
lines.plainText: God and our innocence defend and guard us

content.text: Enter Lovell and Ratcliffe with Hastings' head.

lines.text: Be patient, they are friends, Ratcliffe and Lovell.
lines.plainText: Be patient they are friends Ratcliffe and Lovell

lines.text: Here is the head of that ignoble traitor,
lines.plainText: Here is the head of that ignoble traitor

lines.text: The dangerous and unsuspected Hastings.
lines.plainText: The dangerous and unsuspected Hastings

lines.text: So dear I loved the man that I must weep.
lines.plainText: So dear I loved the man that I must weep

lines.text: I took him for the plainest harmless creature
lines.plainText: I took him for the plainest harmless creature

lines.text: That breathed upon the earth a Christian;
lines.plainText: That breathed upon the earth a Christian

lines.text: Made him my book, wherein my soul recorded
lines.plainText: Made him my book wherein my soul recorded

lines.text: The history of all her secret thoughts.
lines.plainText: The history of all her secret thoughts

lines.text: So smooth he daubed his vice with show of virtue
lines.plainText: So smooth he daubed his vice with show of virtue

lines.text: That, his apparent open guilt omitted—
lines.plainText: That his apparent open guilt omitted

lines.text: I mean his conversation with Shore's wife—
lines.plainText: I mean his conversation with Shore's wife

lines.text: He lived from all attainder of suspects.
lines.plainText: He lived from all attainder of suspects

lines.text: Well, well, he was the covert'st sheltered traitor
lines.plainText: Well well he was the covert'st sheltered traitor

lines.text: That ever lived.—
lines.plainText: That ever lived

lines.text: Would you imagine, or almost believe,
lines.plainText: Would you imagine or almost believe

lines.text: Were't not that by great preservation
lines.plainText: Were't not that by great preservation

lines.text: We live to tell it, that the subtle traitor
lines.plainText: We live to tell it that the subtle traitor

lines.text: This day had plotted, in the council-house,
lines.plainText: This day had plotted in the councilhouse

lines.text: To murder me and my good lord of Gloucester?
lines.plainText: To murder me and my good lord of Gloucester

lines.text: Had he done so?
lines.plainText: Had he done so

lines.text: What, think you we are Turks or Infidels?
lines.plainText: What think you we are Turks or Infidels

lines.text: Or that we would, against the form of law,
lines.plainText: Or that we would against the form of law

lines.text: Proceed thus rashly in the villain's death,
lines.plainText: Proceed thus rashly in the villain's death

lines.text: But that the extreme peril of the case,
lines.plainText: But that the extreme peril of the case

lines.text: The peace of England, and our persons' safety,
lines.plainText: The peace of England and our persons' safety

lines.text: Enforced us to this execution?
lines.plainText: Enforced us to this execution

lines.text: Now, fair befall you! He deserved his death,
lines.plainText: Now fair befall you He deserved his death

lines.text: And your good Graces both have well proceeded,
lines.plainText: And your good Graces both have well proceeded

lines.text: To warn false traitors from the like attempts.
lines.plainText: To warn false traitors from the like attempts

lines.text: I never looked for better at his hands
lines.plainText: I never looked for better at his hands

lines.text: After he once fell in with Mistress Shore.
lines.plainText: After he once fell in with Mistress Shore

lines.text: Yet had we not determined he should die
lines.plainText: Yet had we not determined he should die

lines.text: Until your lordship came to see his end
lines.plainText: Until your lordship came to see his end

lines.text: Which now the loving haste of these our friends,
lines.plainText: Which now the loving haste of these our friends

lines.text: Something against our meanings, have prevented,
lines.plainText: Something against our meanings have prevented

lines.text: Because, my lord, we would have had you heard
lines.plainText: Because my lord we would have had you heard

lines.text: The traitor speak, and timorously confess
lines.plainText: The traitor speak and timorously confess

lines.text: The manner and the purpose of his treasons,
lines.plainText: The manner and the purpose of his treasons

lines.text: That you might well have signified the same
lines.plainText: That you might well have signified the same

lines.text: Unto the citizens, who haply may
lines.plainText: Unto the citizens who haply may

lines.text: Misconster us in him, and wail his death.
lines.plainText: Misconster us in him and wail his death

lines.text: But, my good lord, your Grace's word shall serve
lines.plainText: But my good lord your Grace's word shall serve

lines.text: As well as I had seen and heard him speak;
lines.plainText: As well as I had seen and heard him speak

lines.text: And do not doubt, right noble princes both,
lines.plainText: And do not doubt right noble princes both

lines.text: But I'll acquaint our duteous citizens
lines.plainText: But I'll acquaint our duteous citizens

lines.text: With all your just proceedings in this case.
lines.plainText: With all your just proceedings in this case

lines.text: And to that end we wished your lordship here,
lines.plainText: And to that end we wished your lordship here

lines.text: T' avoid the censures of the carping world.
lines.plainText: T' avoid the censures of the carping world

lines.text: But since you come too late of our intent,
lines.plainText: But since you come too late of our intent

lines.text: Yet witness what you hear we did intend.
lines.plainText: Yet witness what you hear we did intend

lines.text: And so, my good Lord Mayor, we bid farewell.
lines.plainText: And so my good Lord Mayor we bid farewell

lines.text: Go, after, after, cousin Buckingham.
lines.plainText: Go after after cousin Buckingham

lines.text: The Mayor towards Guildhall hies him in all post.
lines.plainText: The Mayor towards Guildhall hies him in all post

lines.text: There, at your meet'st advantage of the time,
lines.plainText: There at your meet'st advantage of the time

lines.text: Infer the bastardy of Edward's children;
lines.plainText: Infer the bastardy of Edward's children

lines.text: Tell them how Edward put to death a citizen
lines.plainText: Tell them how Edward put to death a citizen

lines.text: Only for saying he would make his son
lines.plainText: Only for saying he would make his son

lines.text: Heir to the Crown—meaning indeed his house,
lines.plainText: Heir to the Crownmeaning indeed his house

lines.text: Which, by the sign thereof, was termed so.
lines.plainText: Which by the sign thereof was termed so

lines.text: Moreover, urge his hateful luxury
lines.plainText: Moreover urge his hateful luxury

lines.text: And bestial appetite in change of lust,
lines.plainText: And bestial appetite in change of lust

lines.text: Which stretched unto their servants, daughters, wives,
lines.plainText: Which stretched unto their servants daughters wives

lines.text: Even where his raging eye or savage heart,
lines.plainText: Even where his raging eye or savage heart

lines.text: Without control, lusted to make a prey.
lines.plainText: Without control lusted to make a prey

lines.text: Nay, for a need, thus far come near my person:
lines.plainText: Nay for a need thus far come near my person

lines.text: Tell them, when that my mother went with child
lines.plainText: Tell them when that my mother went with child

lines.text: Of that insatiate Edward, noble York
lines.plainText: Of that insatiate Edward noble York

lines.text: My princely father then had wars in France,
lines.plainText: My princely father then had wars in France

lines.text: And, by true computation of the time,
lines.plainText: And by true computation of the time

lines.text: Found that the issue was not his begot;
lines.plainText: Found that the issue was not his begot

lines.text: Which well appeared in his lineaments,
lines.plainText: Which well appeared in his lineaments

lines.text: Being nothing like the noble Duke, my father.
lines.plainText: Being nothing like the noble Duke my father

lines.text: Yet touch this sparingly, as 'twere far off;
lines.plainText: Yet touch this sparingly as 'twere far off

lines.text: Because, my lord, you know my mother lives.
lines.plainText: Because my lord you know my mother lives

lines.text: Doubt not, my lord, I'll play the orator
lines.plainText: Doubt not my lord I'll play the orator

lines.text: As if the golden fee for which I plead
lines.plainText: As if the golden fee for which I plead

lines.text: Were for myself. And so, my lord, adieu.
lines.plainText: Were for myself And so my lord adieu

lines.text: If you thrive well, bring them to Baynard's Castle,
lines.plainText: If you thrive well bring them to Baynard's Castle

lines.text: Where you shall find me well accompanied
lines.plainText: Where you shall find me well accompanied

lines.text: With reverend fathers and well-learned bishops.
lines.plainText: With reverend fathers and welllearned bishops

lines.text: I go; and towards three or four o'clock
lines.plainText: I go and towards three or four o'clock

lines.text: Look for the news that the Guildhall affords.
lines.plainText: Look for the news that the Guildhall affords

lines.text: Go, Lovell, with all speed to Doctor Shaa.
lines.plainText: Go Lovell with all speed to Doctor Shaa

lines.text: [To Ratcliffe.] Go thou to Friar Penker; bid them both
lines.plainText: To Ratcliffe Go thou to Friar Penker bid them both

lines.text: Meet me within this hour at Baynard's Castle.
lines.plainText: Meet me within this hour at Baynard's Castle
